description: This file defines the class DeleteTestCampaigns, which encapsulates the functionality to delete test campaign records within the SuiteCRM system. It particularly includes the method deleteTestRecords that removes associated email and campaign log records for a specified Campaign instance.

classes.name: DeleteTestCampaigns
classes.description: Class designed to handle deletion of test campaign records in SuiteCRM, specifically targeting associated emails and campaign log entries.

methods.name: deleteTestRecords
methods.description: Deletes test campaign-specific email and campaign log entries for the provided Campaign object.
